notes.title: "Star Shift: Rebellion" Has Launched!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the next chapter in the Star Shift Saga, "[b]Star Shift: Rebellion[/b]," has been launched! Now's your chance to pick up a copy of your own! Launch the Rebellion from your PC!

[previewyoutube=LGeaASEtfK8;full][/previewyoutube]

Infernis Prime: a mining colony on the edge of the Outer Rim, languishes under a brutal occupation. Within the shadows of this forsaken world, a spark of hope flickers. With the help of a hacked android and the discovery of a dark secret, the seeds of the future take root. "Star Shift: Rebellion" unfolds with the gripping tale of the Outer Rim Coalition's formation and their quest for liberation.

[b]The Saga Begins:[/b] Today, you are invited to step into a universe where the fabric of reality is not what it seems, and the line between right and wrong blurs with each revelation. Will you rise as the beacon of hope in a galaxy consumed by darkness? Or will you forge a path of power, regardless of the cost? The legacy of "Star Shift: Rebellion" is not written in the stars but by the hands of those brave enough to take the helm.

[b]Chart Your Course: [/b]Beyond the rebellion, beyond the fight for freedom, lies the truth to alter the course of history. Engage in strategic combat that challenges both your intellect and your resolve. Navigate alliances, uncover secrets, and make decisions that will define the legacy of the Outer Rim Coalition.

The universe of "Star Shift: Rebellion" awaits. Are you ready to uncover the truth, join the fight, and lead the rebellion? Chart Your Course: [b]Join the Rebellion Today![/b]. 

[h2]Epic Space Opera Storyline:[/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/epic-space-opera-storyline.gif[/img][/url]

- Time has been shattered. Only you and your crew can unlock the mystery before it's too late!

[h2]Strategic Turn-Based Combat:[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/Strategic-Turn-Based-Combat-SSR.gif[/img][/url]

- A Mashup of tactical RPG and turn-based strategy elements... with a sci-fi twist!

[h2]Tactical Fleet Combat:[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/tactical-fleet-combat.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]A Diverse Cast Of  Playable Characters:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41524194/13bc9dc3e1658c234d7e3d16e3aabf2ab889626a.png[/img]

-A diverse cast of playable characters with unique skill trees to complement your play-style.

[h2]Complex Skill Tree System:[/h2]
